    <content type="html"><h2>What's Changed</h2>
<h2>General</h2>
<ul>
<li>The official Scorecard docker images are hosted on GitHub Container Registry starting with v5.5.0.<br>
Older releases will be brought over from Google Container/Artifact Registry, before being discontinued.(<a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/spencerschrock/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/spencerschrock">@spencerschrock</a> in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3736424039" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4885" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4885/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4885">#4885</a>)</li>
<li>Scorecard will now skip checks that don't apply to the current repo type by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/JamieMagee/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/JamieMagee">@JamieMagee</a> in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4198362448" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5000" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/5000/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5000">#5000</a>.<br>
If any checks no longer run that previously ran, and you think are supported by the underlying forge please file an issue.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>🌱 Use rulesets if one exists when classic branch protection rule is inaccessible by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/trask/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/trask">@trask</a> in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3645345500" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4853" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4853/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4853">#4853</a></li>
</ul>

    <content type="html"><h2>What's Changed</h2>
<h2>General</h2>
<ul>
<li>✨ Added CLI flags to scan multiple repositories <code>--repos</code>, or an entire GitHub organization <code>--org</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3423714534" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4793" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4793/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4793">#4793</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/gabrielsoltz/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/gabrielsoltz">@gabrielsoltz</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h2>Checks</h2>
<h3>Branch-Protection</h3>
<ul>
<li>🐛 Fix branch-protection scoring so GitHub rulesets without include patterns are honored, eliminating false warnings for branches covered by those rulesets. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3576506184" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4835" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4835/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4835">#4835</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/trask/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/trask">@trask</a>)</li>
</ul>

(<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="2764702637" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4474" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4474/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4474">#4474</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/spencerschrock/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/spencerschrock">@spencerschrock</a>)
<ul>
<li>The default method if unspecified is <code>--file-mode archive</code> which is what older versions of Scorecard always used.</li>
<li><code>--file-mode git</code> produces the most accurate results for repositories with <code>.gitattributes</code> files at the cost of analysis speed. This currently only supports GitHub but can be expanded to other forges in the future.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>The Scorecard binary name in releases is now consistent across all platforms (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="2846650914" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4520" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4520/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4520">#4520</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/timothysparg/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/timothysparg">@timothysparg</a>)</li>
<li>Scorecard now prints a warning if multiple GitHub PAT environment variables are set with different values. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="2774319381" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4483" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4483/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4483">#4483</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/aunovis-heidrich/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/aunovis-heidrich">@aunovis-heidrich</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h2>Azure DevOps Support (Experimental)</h2>
<p>There is now experimental support for Azure DevOps repositories (thanks <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/JamieMagee/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/JamieMagee">@JamieMagee</a>). Most checks should work, but the following checks do not: <code>Branch-Protection</code>,  <code>SBOM</code>, and <code>Signed-Releases</code>.</p>
<p>To analyze a repository:</p>
<ol>
<li>Set the <code>SCORECARD_EXPERIMENTAL</code> environment variable to any value.</li>
<li>Put your access token in the <code>AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_TOKEN</code> environment variable.</li>
</ol>

    <content type="html"><h1>What's Changed</h1>
<p>We’ll highlight the major changes between <code>v4.13.1</code> and <code>v5.0.0</code> below, as well as some of the changes between <code>v5.0.0-rc2</code> and <code>v5.0.0</code>. For a more complete picture, see the <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/releases/tag/v5.0.0-rc1">v5.0.0-rc1</a> and <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/releases/tag/v5.0.0-rc2">v5.0.0-rc2</a> changelogs as well.</p>
<h2>Structured Results</h2>
<p>Structured Results is the main feature from this release. At a high level, structured results involve breaking the existing 19 Scorecard Checks into individual heuristics so users can pick and choose which ones they care about. You can see a list of all supported probes by checking out our <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/docs/probes.md">documentation</a> (paying attention to <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/probes/README.md#lifecycle">lifecycle / stability guarantees</a>). To run individual probes, use the <code>--probes</code> CLI flag with a comma separated list of names. You must also specify the <code>--format probe</code> option to see the results. Please run <code>scorecard --help</code> if you need more details.<br>
Example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="scorecard --repo github.com/ossf/scorecard --probes archived,fuzzed,hasLicenseFile --format probe"><pre>scorecard --repo github.com/ossf/scorecard --probes archived,fuzzed,hasLicenseFile --format probe</pre></div>
<p>For more details on the feature, please check out our <a href="https://openssf.org/blog/2024/04/17/beyond-scores-with-openssf-scorecard-granular-structured-results-for-custom-policy-enforcement/" rel="nofollow">blog post</a> or the talk given at Open Source Summit NA 2024: <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZT3XdMF6U5A" rel="nofollow">Structured Scorecard Results: Tailor Your Own Supply-Chain Security Policies</a>.</p>
<h2>Maintainer Annotations</h2>
<p>Maintainer Annotations let maintainers add context to display alongside Scorecard check results. Annotations can provide users additional information when Scorecard has an incomplete assessment of a project's security practices. To see the maintainers annotations for each check, if present, use the <code>--show-annotations</code> option. For example, the <code>not-detected</code> annotation can annotate when a maintainer fulfills a check or probe in a way that is supported by Scorecard but not identified.</p>
<p>For more details, check out our <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/config/README.md">documentation</a> for the feature.</p>
<h2>Breaking Changes</h2>
<h3>API changes</h3>
<p>The biggest change is that everything in <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ossf/scorecard/v4/pkg" rel="nofollow">github.com/ossf/scorecard/v4/pkg</a> now lives in <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ossf/scorecard/v5/pkg/scorecard" rel="nofollow">github.com/ossf/scorecard/v5/pkg/scorecard</a>. This allows renaming of some function names and types to be less repetitive.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>RunScorecard</code> is now <code>Run</code></li>
<li><code>ScorecardResult</code> is now <code>Result</code></li>
</ul>
<p>Expected changes:</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pkg.ScorecardRun() -&gt; scorecard.Run()
pkg.ScorecardResult -&gt; scorecard.Result"><pre class="notranslate"><code>pkg.ScorecardRun() -&gt; scorecard.Run()
pkg.ScorecardResult -&gt; scorecard.Result
</code></pre></div>
<p>The signature of <code>RunScorecard</code> (now called <code>Run</code>) has changed to allow for fewer breaking changes in the future. For full motivation, see the <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/3717" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/issues/3717/hovercard">associated issue</a>. There should be fewer setup code needed than before. Callers no longer need to pass in all clients and arguments and can rely on sensible default behavior. Callers that want to customize the analysis can influence the results with our Option types.</p>
<p>A <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4151" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4151/hovercard">similar change</a> was done with formatting the results, which now accept an option struct pointer. Using a nil pointer will use default values.</p>
<h3>Unlikely to cause issues</h3>
<p>These changes are technically breaking in a semver sense, but we don’t expect most users to depend on them or require changes.</p>
<ul>
<li>Dependency diff functionality has been removed in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="2336765929" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/4146" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ossf/scorecard/pull/4146/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4146">#4146</a>.
<ul>
<li>For GitHub replacements, consider <a href="https://github.com/actions/dependency-review-action">actions/dependency-review-action</a> which now supports showing Scorecard data.</li>
</ul>
</li>

<h2>What's Changed</h2>
<h3>Structured Results</h3>
<p>We invite users to try out a preview of Structured Results, the main feature from this release candidate. For more details on the feature, please check out the first paragraph of our <a href="https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/probes/README.md">probes README</a> as well as our <a href="https://openssf.org/blog/2024/04/17/beyond-scores-with-openssf-scorecard-granular-structured-results-for-custom-policy-enforcement/" rel="nofollow">blog post</a>.</p>
<p>At a high level, structured results involves breaking the existing 19 Scorecard Checks into individual heuristics so users can pick and choose which ones they care about. You can see a list of all supported probes by checking out the <code>probes/</code> directory. To run individual probes, use the <code>--probes</code> CLI flag with a comma separated list of names. You must also specify the <code>--format probe</code> option to see the results. Please run <code>scorecard --help</code> if you need more details.</p>
<p>Example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="scorecard --repo github.com/ossf/scorecard --probes archived,fuzzed,hasLicenseFile --format probe"><pre>scorecard --repo github.com/ossf/scorecard --probes archived,fuzzed,hasLicenseFile --format probe</pre></div>
